caption: The drawing displays a single long dress with a fitted bodice and a wide skirt, shown from the front and accompanied by a smaller line sketch of the back view in the upper right area. The primary dress is rendered in shades of soft brown and peach, featuring large, ornate patterns of leaves in slightly darker reddish-brown and pinkish hues. The bodice is shaped to the waist with a flared, skirted bottom edge and decorated with small round buttons down the center front. The sleeves are long and end at the wrist, trimmed with white lace cuffs. The neckline is square and also trimmed with lace. Along the hem of the skirt is a fringe or braid trim in a similar gold-brown color. The background of the drawing is plain and light beige, without any additional objects present.
title: Dinner Dress
